title: plesiohedron-census: certified space-filling polyhedra from a gated agentic search (code, certificates, catalog)
description: Code, per-cell certificates and THE CATALOG (version 5, snapshot 2026-09-04) from an exact-arithmetic search for plesiohedra (Voronoi cells of point orbits under crystallographic space groups) across the 36 cubic, 68 tetragonal and 52 trigonal/hexagonal space groups: 1,583 exact-confirmed combinatorial types, 177 with tiling, symmetry and polyform-count certificates, reconciled at f-vector and type level against the 3,315 printed rows of Schmitt's 2016 survey tables. Two cubic cells carry names (Satchelhedron, Ordenhedron) with their diligence scope stated in the README; nothing here claims a shape is new to science. Code is MIT-licensed; data and catalog files are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE). Computation and drafting assisted by Claude (Anthropic); every result document names the command that reproduces it.
